# Mission Canvas

> Custom software built around your business, with ongoing maintenance and agreed improvements. Start with one workflow and a clear scope of care.

Mission Canvas offers Customized Software as a Service: custom software built around a business workflow, with scoped maintenance and agreed improvements. Each engagement defines the build, costs, deployment and ongoing care. Book a workflow audit: https://pretendhome.github.io/audit/

Sound familiar?
Software shouldn't need a workaround for the workaround.
Every company has them.
The spreadsheet that fixes the CRM.
The manual check that keeps the process from going wrong.
The person everyone asks because the system doesn't tell them what to do.
It's easy to call this "just how we work." It isn't. It's what happens when the software stops matching the business.
We build around how you actually work, then maintain and improve the software as your business changes.
How it works

## We build it. Then we stay with it.
01 Audit 02 Redesign 03 Assemble 04 Operate

### Audit
We sit with your team and follow the work: the tools, information, handoffs and decisions. Together, we choose a useful first scope. What you get
Workflow map · Agreed first scope How long it all takes
Build timing is agreed after the audit. Maintenance and improvements continue within your care agreement.

### Redesign
We shape a clearer workflow, with the business rules, review steps and responsibilities your team needs. What you get
Your workflow, defined together How long it all takes
Build timing is agreed after the audit. Maintenance and improvements continue within your care agreement.

We build your custom software on a reusable foundation, connect the agreed tools, and review it with your team. What you get
Your software, built around your work How long it all takes
Build timing is agreed after the audit. Maintenance and improvements continue within your care agreement.

### Operate
We maintain and support the software within your care agreement, then improve it with you as your business changes. What you get

## Questions.
What is Mission Canvas?
Customized Software as a Service: custom software built around your workflow, with ongoing maintenance, support and improvement as your business changes. We start with the work your team needs to do. Who is it for?
Businesses whose recurring work runs across documents, records, messages and systems. The industry examples on this site illustrate workflows we can discuss and scope around your team. How is it different from ChatGPT or other AI chat tools?
Chat tools help with questions and drafts. Mission Canvas builds software around your workflow, information and business rules, then agrees how it will be maintained and improved. AI is one possible tool within that solution. What happens in the audit?
We walk through a recurring task with your team: the tools, information, handoffs and decisions. Together, we identify a useful first scope and what a successful result would look like. How long does it take?
We agree delivery timing after reviewing the scope, integrations and access needed. Ongoing maintenance and improvement are defined in the care agreement.

About Mission Canvas

# Your software should grow with your work.
Customized Software as a Service: we build around your workflow, then maintain and improve it with you.

## The team.

### Jason Covington
Fractional CFO, CPO and COO practice.

### Mical Neill
Twelve years in voice and knowledge systems.

### Daniele Mulas
IT, and making things useful to real people.

### Pierfrancesco Borghero
Running development teams.

## What we believe.

### Software shaped to your workflows.
Your work spans email, calendars, documents, drives and people’s knowledge. We build around a specific workflow and the tools you use.

### You decide what runs where.
We agree where your application runs, what it can access and which AI models it may use. Changes follow the same review.

### Care continues after launch.
Useful software needs maintenance and feedback. We agree how it will be supported and improved as the work changes.

## What we’re working toward.
These are outcomes we’re working to prove, not results we claim today.

### Give people their time back
Cut repetitive work, so attention goes to people, ideas and decisions.

### Make AI understandable
Systems you can see into, explain and check. No black boxes.

### Connect what you know
Turn scattered information into something your team can search and share.

### Keep what people know
Capture how work is done before it leaves with someone who retires.

### AI for everyone
Let anyone design a workflow, not only developers and data scientists.

### Work better together
Let teams build, share and improve their workflows together.

### Earn trust
Privacy, security and human oversight first. Technology should earn trust, not demand it.

## Wherever paperwork piles up.
A useful first workflow might be administrative intake, document preparation or recurring checks. We agree
the information, permissions and human review it needs before building it.
The build and ongoing care are scoped for your business. Regulated work needs its own professional review.

Download

# Download the apps.
Existing desktop apps for Mac, Windows and Linux. A download is separate from a custom workflow build and an ongoing care agreement.

## Palette
Free desktop app. Separate from custom care.
Mac Windows Linux

## Education
Existing education desktop workspace
Mac Windows Linux

## Logistics
Existing logistics desktop workspace
Mac Windows Linux Sample data

## After it downloads.
- Mac Open the.dmg and drag the app into Applications. Palette is signed and notarized.
If macOS still says the app can't be verified, right-click it and choose Open.
- Windows Run the -Setup.exe installer. It is not yet code-signed, so SmartScreen shows
"Windows protected your PC": click More info, then Run anyway.
- Linux Palette is a.deb: open it with your software installer, or run
sudo apt install ~/Downloads/MissionCanvas.deb. The other apps are.AppImage files,
which download without permission to run, so double-clicking does nothing. In a terminal, chmod +x
the file, then run it. On Ubuntu 22.04 or newer, first sudo apt install libfuse2. On Ubuntu 24.04 an
AppImage may quit at once with a "SUID sandbox" error; start it with --no-sandbox.
For developers

## Install the command line.
A terminal build for questions against a repository or folder. It ships separately from the apps above and
does not include a custom workflow or care agreement. Developer docs
macOS / Linux curl -fsSL https://missioncanvas.ai/install-cli.sh | sh
Windows irm https://missioncanvas.ai/install-cli.ps1 | iex

Construction and Real Estate

# Construction job costing and fleet software Run the job, not the paperwork.
Job site, office and fleet in one system, with AI doing the back-office work. Customized for your crew,
on your own computers, with ongoing care.
Book an audit Start with one workflow. Meet Livella

## What it handles today.
These parts work now. We agree the custom work, connections and ongoing care your business needs
before we build.
- 01

### Every job site in one record
Status, crews, documents and progress in one place. Each job’s costs run from estimate to actuals and stay current.
- 02

### Delivery tickets read by AI
Inbound and outbound delivery tickets are digitised, read automatically and tied to the right job.
- 03

### Safety and quality without paper
Protective equipment is assigned and declarations stay compliant. Concrete pours and material quality are logged to code.
- 04

### Fleet and fuel
Equipment records, due dates and job-site assignments. Fuel tracked by machine and by job. Scheduled maintenance and driver contracts linked.
- 05

### Crew and hiring
Employee records and roles without spreadsheets. AI screens résumés from application to shortlist.
- 06

### Office paperwork
Mileage reimbursements calculated and printed to PDF. Payments to vendors and employees ordered, tracked and approved. Invoices read automatically.
- 07

### An assistant that knows the business
Answers questions from the firm’s own data. Field notes can be dictated and transcribed automatically.
Meet Livella

## Livella
Job site, office and fleet in one system, with AI doing the back-office work.
Livella is the construction app we start from: a web app for the office and a field app for the site, with
unlimited field users.
Book an audit Start with one workflow.
Runs every day at an Italian construction firm that pays for it and whose own work it was built around.

## A scoped build. Ongoing care.
A scoped custom build, followed by agreed maintenance and improvements.

### Audit
We walk through how a job moves from the site to the office: notes, delivery tickets, fuel, costs.

### Redesign
We cut the steps where someone retypes the same thing into another system.

### Assemble
We customize Livella around your jobs, your cost codes and your forms.

### Operate
Your crew uses it on live jobs. We maintain it and agree improvements with you.

## Your job files stay on your computer.
- Files are read and organized on a computer you already own. No data migration. No new cloud account.
- If you use an outside AI model, only what that task needs is sent, and it's logged.
- You can run local models instead, and send nothing out. How we handle your data

Canvases CV-01 Education

# Private AI for schools A living picture of every student, on your own machines.
Custom school software, with ongoing care. Record observations in under a minute; student lenses track strategies, accommodations and CEFR milestones. Student data stays at school.
Book an audit Start with one workflow.

## What it handles today.
These parts work now. Custom work and ongoing care are scoped around your business.
- 01

### Student and classroom lenses
A learning profile for each student and each class that keeps growing across grades and teachers.
- 02

### Progress notes and IEPs
Bring in a note that covers several students. Each student gets only their own part, with a confidence badge.
- 03

### Summaries for parents
Drafted only from confirmed lens entries. Nothing goes home until every sentence traces back to one.
- 04

### Exercises from your coursework
Activities adapted from the school’s own coursework and textbooks, in three tiers.

## See it on a real day.
A recording of the shipped build, unedited.
Education · recording ↑ Recorded 21 September 2026 on version 0.2.106, unedited: roster import, a report card into the lenses, an observation, a summary and a three-tier activity. The class is a sample.
Tested against live data · Runs on your own computers · Scoped build and ongoing care
Everything it already does: 8 modules, 42 features
- M-01 Students A lens per student, built from what the school already writes down.
- M-02 Observe A short note, attached to the right child, in under a minute.
- M-03 Assess Language work reviewed, not graded by a machine.
- M-04 Prepare and Plan Lessons from the coursework the teacher already has.
- M-05 Summaries What goes home is checked before it goes.
- M-06 Ask Questions answered on the machine, and it says so.
- M-07 Governance and privacy The verdict is computed from the log, not asserted.
- M-08 Coordinator views The school, seen across classrooms.

# Docs
The command line is a developer tool under construction, separate from a custom build and care agreement.
Full documentation is not published yet; the installer names these three starting commands.
- mc setup configure models
- mc run "query" ask something
- mc health system status

Questions

# Asked before every audit.
If yours is not here, ask it in the audit, or write to us from the audit page.

## The basics
What is Mission Canvas?
Customized Software as a Service: custom software built around your workflow, with ongoing maintenance, support and improvement as your business changes. We start with the work your team needs to do. Who is it for?
Businesses whose recurring work runs across documents, records, messages and systems. The industry examples on this site illustrate workflows we can discuss and scope around your team. How is it different from ChatGPT or other AI chat tools?
Chat tools help with questions and drafts. Mission Canvas builds software around your workflow, information and business rules, then agrees how it will be maintained and improved. AI is one possible tool within that solution. What happens in the audit?
We walk through a recurring task with your team: the tools, information, handoffs and decisions. Together, we identify a useful first scope and what a successful result would look like. How long does it take?
We agree delivery timing after reviewing the scope, integrations and access needed. Ongoing maintenance and improvement are defined in the care agreement. What is a canvas?
An industry workflow outline that helps frame a custom project. The examples show possible scopes, while your people, rules and systems shape what we build on our reusable foundation.

## Cost and ownership
What does it cost?
A scoped setup and build, followed by recurring care, with final figures and terms agreed by quote. Hosting, third-party services and usage costs are separate unless the quote includes them. Who owns what you build?
Ownership, licensing, access and handover rights are defined in your agreement before you commit. What if we stop working together?
Your agreement sets out the handover, data export and ongoing operating responsibilities, including any outside services the software needs.

## Your data and your systems
Does our data leave our computers?
The project defines where information is processed, who can access it and which connected services receive it. Local processing and external connections are scoped for your workflow before use. Do we need new hardware?
We assess your existing equipment, hosting needs and connected systems during scoping, then identify what the proposed solution requires. Can we keep the tools we use today?
We start with the tools and records you already use. Integrations depend on available interfaces, permissions and vendor limits, and are agreed in the project scope. What is Palette?
Our desktop foundation and development application. Palette has its own capabilities and setup requirements; a Mission Canvas service engagement separately defines your custom workflow, delivery and ongoing care.

## Do what you do best. We'll handle the software.
A clear build scope. An agreed plan for ongoing care. Book an audit
Start with one workflow.

Source: https://pretendhome.github.io/how-it-works

How it works

# Built around your work. Cared for as it changes.
We connect the information your workflow needs, build around your process and agree how to keep the software useful.
Book an audit Start with one workflow.

## The four steps
01 Read 02 Sort 03 Connect 04 Work

### Start with what you have.
Files, exports and records, read on your own machines. Nothing to move, nothing to retype. What you get
A private index of what your company knows

### Work out what each file is about.
It finds the people, customers, orders, documents, processes and equipment behind the files. What you get
The things your business is made of

### See how it all fits together.
It links those things into one picture of how your company works, so the AI gets the connections, not just loose text. What you get
One connected map of your company

### Put that knowledge to work.
The application uses this context for your workflow. Models, connected services and access are agreed for the implementation. What you get
Context for agents and for your industry’s application

around your workflow, with the care and improvements agreed for your business.
01 Ask in plain words "Where is REF-7100?" The answer gives the stage, owner, carrier and tracking number, with the records it came from listed underneath. 02 It keeps the thread "Tell me about them," then "show their late orders." Customer data is marked local-only on every answer. 03 It says no when it should A question it cannot classify gets "unknown", stays on the machine, and is blocked from going to an outside model.

Mission Canvas Palette

# The free local AI app for your documents: Palette
It asks first. Then it shows its work.
A free app for your computer. Give it one folder. It lists what is there without opening a file, reads only what
you allow, and builds a document from the facts you accept. Every line leads back to the sentence it came from.
Mac Windows Linux
Palette runs on a computer.
Send yourself this page
and open it there.
Free. No account. Version 0.4.1, released 15 October 2026. Mac is signed and notarised. Windows is not yet
signed, so SmartScreen will warn you once: what to click, and how to check the file.
The design we are building toward. The app as it ships today is below, screen by screen.
See it work · 105 seconds, unedited

## Ask, change, read it back.
One take on the sample notes: a spoken request finds nineteen facts and the document appears; a spoken change and
a clicked one each become a new version; then it reads the document aloud in a voice that runs on the machine.
Recorded 21 September 2026 on a build of 0.3.8 with the two changes that shipped in 0.3.9: the note bar sits at
the bottom, and spoken requests apply without a confirm card.
Download the recording, 5 MB
The rules it keeps · each one can be checked in the app
Most AI apps tell you what they will do for you. This one is easier to describe by what it will not do without you.
- 01

### It never goes looking.
It works on the folders you hand it, one at a time. It does not search the rest of the computer on its own.
- 02

### It reads nothing until you say so.
Listing a folder opens no file. Reading starts when you press Grant, and every file it read is listed afterwards.
- 03

### Nothing in the document is made up.
Today the document is the facts you accepted, in a fixed layout. If a fact is not in your notes, it is not in the document. Written summaries come next, held to the same rule: every sentence leads back to a source.
- 04

### Nothing it keeps is hidden.
On Home, what you asked for is kept and listed on screen in the same turn, and every version of the document is kept. In a matter, your words wait on a card until you keep them.
- 05

### It does not need a model to work.
The sample runs with no AI model installed and no key. The app says so on screen.
- 06

### It keeps a list of what it connects to.
The app keeps a list of the connections it has made. On a fresh install, after the whole sample, that list reads “none yet”.
The first five minutes · screens from version 0.3.7, not drawings

## What you will see, in the order you will see it.
These are the app's own screens, taken from version 0.3.7 running the sample notes. Since then the note bar has
moved to the bottom, and requests on Home no longer wait on a card. The steps are the same, and they run on your
own folder.
- 01 It opens empty, with one button Nothing to set up and no account. “Try it with sample notes” places four invented notes in the app’s own folder, so you can see the whole thing work before it touches anything of yours.
- 02 It shows you a folder before it reads it Names and counts only. No file is opened to make this list. It says what it would read, what it would skip and why, and waits for you to grant the folder.
- 03 You say what you want. It asks before keeping anything Type it or hold the mic. It finds the facts in the notes you granted and holds them on a card. On Home in 0.3.9 it keeps them in the same turn and lists what it kept.
- 04 The document is the facts you accepted Today it is a template, filled in, so there is no sentence in it that nobody wrote. The panel on the right says which model wrote the draft: none.
- 05 Every line leads back to its sentence Each claim sits beside the words it came from and the file they are in. Nineteen claims, nineteen sources.
- 06 Click a value to change it Or say the change out loud. It shows the change on a card, you confirm, and the document becomes version 2. Version 1 is kept.

The panel on the right says which model wrote the draft: none. Every line leads back to its sentence Each claim sits beside the words it came from and the file they are in. Nineteen claims, nineteen sources. Click a value to change it Or say the change out loud. It shows the change on a card, you confirm, and the document becomes version 2. Version 1 is kept.
What it is for, and what it is not

## Good for
- A review, brief or summary sheet assembled from scattered notes
- Finding out where a number in a document came from
- Seeing what is in a folder before anything is allowed to read it
- Work where a wrong sentence is expensive

## Not for
- Searching the web
- Your inbox or your calendar
- Booking, buying or doing errands
- Free writing: emails, essays, posts
Today It reads plain text:.txt,.md,.csv,.json
and.ics. PDFs and Office files are listed and skipped, and it tells you so. It is an early build, and it
is honest about where it stops.
Install · version 0.4.1 · 15 October 2026
- Mac
Open MissionCanvas.dmg and drag the app into Applications. It is signed and notarised. If macOS still says it cannot be verified, right-click the app and choose Open. Download for Mac, 683 MB
- Windows
Run MissionCanvas-Setup.exe. The installer is not yet code-signed, so SmartScreen shows “Windows protected your PC”. Click More info, then Run anyway. If you would rather check the file first, its SHA-256 is below. Download for Windows, 637 MB
- Linux
Open MissionCanvas.deb with your software installer, or run sudo apt install ~/Downloads/MissionCanvas.deb. Download for Linux, 701 MB
The files are still named MissionCanvas. They are Palette. SHA-256: check the file you downloaded

are the digests GitHub publishes for release desktop-v0.4.1; this page reads them when it is built.

## Choose how your software will be built and cared for.

### Build in-house
Your team takes responsibility for the build, connected systems, ongoing maintenance and changes as the business grows.

### Choose a product
Use an existing product where its features, configuration and support terms fit the workflow your team needs.

### Build with us
We build around your workflow and agree its ongoing care. The scope, price and responsibilities are clear before you commit.
This is our proposed service model. Your quote defines the build and recurring care, with hosting, third-party
subscriptions and usage costs listed separately unless included. Delivery timing, support arrangements and
ownership terms are agreed for your scope.

A scoped setup and build, followed by recurring care, with final figures and terms agreed by quote. Hosting, third-party services and usage costs are separate unless the quote includes them. Who owns what you build?
Ownership, licensing, access and handover rights are defined in your agreement before you commit. What if we stop working together?
Your agreement sets out the handover, data export and ongoing operating responsibilities, including any outside services the software needs.

Last updated October 23, 2026 · Draft

# Your data, in plain words.
Your custom workflow needs clear rules for information and access. This page explains enquiries through this
website; deployment and data handling for your application are agreed separately.

## What this website collects
- No form submission to this site. The audit forms prepare a message in your email app for you
to review and send. We receive it only when you send it.
- No cookies or site analytics. This website sets no cookies and runs no analytics today.
Hosting and email providers may keep technical logs under their own policies.
- Arranging a time. The calendar is a preview until booking is configured. Use email to arrange
a conversation; choosing a preview slot does not confirm a meeting.

## Why we collect it
Only to discuss your workflow, arrange a conversation and follow up about it. We don't sell it, rent it or use it for
advertising.

## Your email stays with your email provider
Email integration is scoped with the provider you use, such as Google Workspace, Microsoft 365, or an IMAP and
SMTP service. We agree the custom application's permitted access and the responsibilities for maintaining
that connection before work starts.

## How our software handles your business files
- Deployment and access to files are agreed for your workflow.
- Any outside AI provider and the information it may receive are agreed before use.
- Maintenance access, records and changes are defined in your care agreement.

Source: https://pretendhome.github.io/security

Your data

# Your workflow. Your data. Clear controls.
We agree where the application runs, what it can access and what needs human review. Maintenance and changes follow the controls scoped for your implementation.
Your data

## Your information. Clear control.
We agree where your information is processed, what the software may use and which actions need your instruction.
Ongoing care follows those boundaries.

### Read
It reads what you already have.
Selected files, exports and records, with access agreed for your workflow.

### Sort
It finds what your business is made of.
Customers, orders, documents, people, equipment and processes, in whatever format they were left.

### Connect
It links them into one picture.
Relevant files, jobs and records, connected around the work your team needs to do.

### Work
The AI works from that picture.
The implementation defines which tools and models are used, with the information and permissions the task needs.

### Deployment agreed with you
We agree what runs on your computers and which connected services the workflow needs.

### Your information, your choices
Define what information the software may use and which outside services may receive it.

### Consequential actions in view
Agree what needs a person to review or instruct, and how results are recorded.

### Care with a clear scope
Maintenance, support access and changes are defined for the implementation, with responsibilities made clear.
What ongoing care should mean
Understand which information the software uses, where it is processed and who can access it. These choices belong in the project scope. Our approach · Information and access
Ongoing care should explain maintenance, support and agreed improvements. Access to maintain software is
separate from permission to reuse your private records for other customers or model training.
Our approach · Maintenance and improvements
Our foundation supports source references, version history and recorded actions. Each implementation is checked
against the workflow and controls agreed with your team.

## Questions about data.
Does our data leave our computers?
The project defines where information is processed, who can access it and which connected services receive it. Local processing and external connections are scoped for your workflow before use. Do we need new hardware?
We assess your existing equipment, hosting needs and connected systems during scoping, then identify what the proposed solution requires. Can we keep the tools we use today?
We start with the tools and records you already use. Integrations depend on available interfaces, permissions and vendor limits, and are agreed in the project scope.
For how this website and a workflow enquiry handle your details, read the privacy page.

A clear build scope. An agreed plan for ongoing care. Book an audit

Why Mission Canvas

# Your workflow deserves software built around it.
Customized Software as a Service brings a focused custom build together with ongoing care. We start with your
work, build on a reusable foundation, and improve the software with you as your business changes.

## Scattered information
Documents, messages and records hold different parts of the same piece of work.

## Awkward handoffs
People move information between spreadsheets, email and systems to keep a process moving.

## Changing requirements
Your business evolves, and the software supporting it needs someone responsible for its care.

## Find the right fit for the work.
Question Existing software Mission Canvas
What shapes the workflow The product’s features and configuration Your team’s workflow, information and business rules
How you pay The vendor’s published or negotiated terms Scoped build plus recurring care, agreed by quote
What changes Updates and options offered by the vendor Improvements agreed around your business needs
Who it is for Teams whose needs fit the product Businesses that need software shaped around their work

## How Mission Canvas makes money.
A scoped setup and build, followed by recurring care. Final figures, responsibilities and outside costs are
agreed by quote. Read the proposed model on the pricing page.

### Keep actions clear

Agree maintenance, support, ownership and handover terms so responsibilities stay clear throughout the relationship. Read how we handle your data
